args.body:
- Warehouse automation in 2026 drove an 18% increase in pick rates with autonomous carts.
- Integration took twice as long as planned, a key implementation risk.
- The biggest cost saving came from fewer mis-picks (per the companion piece).

Sources: https://blog.halvorsen.example/2026/warehouse and https://insights.halvorsen.example/warehouse/companion
args.title: Warehouse Automation 2026 — Halvorsen Blog + Companion Summary
